Huge.description: An integer is a number with no fraction, by its exact value: 1e400 is one, though a JavaScript number cannot hold it.

Tiny.description: 1e-400 is not, though a JavaScript number rounds it to 0.

Decimals.description: Values meet by their exact value, whatever their notation: 1.25 is 1.250, 100 is 1e2.

TinyMax.description: A count that is not an integer is ignored.
